plain_language_summary: Blue light therapy devices are consumer wellness products commonly discussed for skin-facing routines and targeted light exposure.
educational_notes: Blue light therapy should be framed conservatively and should not be presented as a disease treatment or cure.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice.

plain_language_summary: Blue light refers to visible light in the blue range of the spectrum.
educational_notes: Device output, wavelength range, distance, and session time may vary by product. Users should follow device-specific instructions.
safety_framing: Avoid direct eye exposure unless the product instructions specifically allow it. Use eye protection when appropriate.

plain_language_summary: Blue light and red light are different parts of the visible light spectrum and are commonly discussed for different wellness device contexts.
educational_notes: Red light is often discussed for red light therapy routines, while blue light is often discussed in skin-facing device education.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Avoid assuming different wavelengths have the same use or safety profile.

plain_language_summary: Beginner blue light sessions should follow the device instructions and should be based on comfort, distance, and target area.
educational_notes: More exposure is not automatically better. Conservative beginner use is preferred.
safety_framing: Stop use if irritation, discomfort, unusual sensitivity, or skin reaction occurs.

plain_language_summary: Blue light devices are often discussed in relation to skin-facing routines.
educational_notes: People with sensitive skin, active irritation, or dermatology concerns should be cautious and seek professional guidance when unsure.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not a substitute for dermatology or medical care.

plain_language_summary: Blue light exposure can be uncomfortable or inappropriate for the eyes depending on device design and use.
educational_notes: Eye protection and proper positioning may be important depending on the product.
safety_framing: Avoid looking directly into bright light sources. Follow product eye-safety guidance.

plain_language_summary: People with light sensitivity or medication-related photosensitivity should be cautious with blue light devices.
educational_notes: Some medications and conditions may increase light sensitivity.
safety_framing: Consult a qualified healthcare professional if light sensitivity, prescription medication use, or health concerns are present.

plain_language_summary: Beginners should understand that wavelength, output, distance, timing, and skin comfort all affect light-device routines.
educational_notes: Blue light education should focus on responsible use, product instructions, and conservative safety framing.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, or prevention.
